title: checkFile
description: Wait for a finished file, and optionally check its text. A file is finished once it has no `.crdownload` or `.part` suffix, no in-progress sibling of the same name with one of those suffixes, and its size stays the same for 250 ms. Outputs `filePath`, `fileName`, and `fileSize`.

anyOf.title: Check file (simple)
anyOf.description: Glob for the file to wait for. A relative path resolves against the spec file.

path.description: Glob for the file to wait for. A relative path resolves against the spec file. When several files match, the newest finished one counts.

download.description: Glob for a file name in the context's download folder. Each `checkFile` returns the oldest finished download that no earlier `checkFile` in the context returned. Needs a desktop Chrome or Firefox context opened by an earlier step. In other contexts, the step is skipped.

content.description: Text the file must contain, read as UTF-8. A value that starts and ends with `/` is a regular expression.

timeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a finished match.
